## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should use the same revision identifier as history; it currently truncates revisions to seven characters instead of twelve. This review read both changed files completely and checked the existing and added tests without running them.

## Changes
The pull request adds a running deployment status containing a shortened revision and an attempt label, plus tests for the status format and attempt labels.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Match history’s twelve-character revision identifier — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status(revision, 2)` displays `0123456`, while history displays `0123456789ab`. Your docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but `revision[:7]` contradicts history’s `revision[:12]`. The status test checks only the prefix and attempt suffix, so it misses this mismatch. — Users cannot consistently match the displayed revision across deployment outputs, and revisions sharing seven characters become indistinguishable even when history distinguishes them.
